name: 合同关联项目明细
description: 合同与项目管理应用的数据共享查询（核心跨应用关联）
statement: SELECT c.contract_no AS contract_no, c.contract_name AS contract_name, c.contract_amount AS contract_amount, c.contract_status AS contract_status, c.project_no AS project_no, c.sign_unit AS sign_unit, p.project_name AS project_name, p.manager AS project_manager, p.total_budget AS project_budget, p.project_status AS project_status FROM contract_main c LEFT JOIN project_master p ON p.project_no = c.project_no
sql: SELECT c.contract_no AS contract_no, c.contract_name AS contract_name, c.contract_amount AS contract_amount, c.contract_status AS contract_status, c.project_no AS project_no, c.sign_unit AS sign_unit, p.project_name AS project_name, p.manager AS project_manager, p.total_budget AS project_budget, p.project_status AS project_status FROM contract_main c LEFT JOIN project_master p ON p.project_no = c.project_no
